Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Staff Infrastructure Engineer position. In my previous role, I scaled Kafka infrastructure to handle 1.8M events/sec [C-01] and optimized cloud spend by 35% across 200 nodes [C-04].

Alex Rivera
notes: Generated in Gemini Desktop Companion with focus on cloud scale and cost efficiency.
